rationale: Two-corpus F5 gate wave (rack second corpus) regression pins, verified on rack + rake at 100%/0/0 (2026-09). RB-A: `Class.new { ... }.new` has an expression receiver — an anonymous instantiation; NO calls:new junk may be emitted (rack spec_lock.rb: 3 Global->new fabrications). RB-B: default-argument VALUE expressions are call sites of the method (mutex = Mutex.new -> instantiates from initialize; app = @app -> uses from context) — previously only the body was walked. RB-C: `class X < Struct.new(...)` superclass expressions construct the base; the Struct.new call must surface as an instantiates (rack directory.rb DirectoryBody). RB-D: member reads with no enclosing def (spec/DSL blocks) belong to the file-level owner Global (rack spec_media_type.rb @content_type/@empty_hash). RB-E: alias_method makes the alias a callable member — calls:local_path with aliasedTo (rack uploaded_file.rb).
